title_en: Urgent Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Concentrated Clearance of Cases of Overdue Project Payments and Migrant Workers' Wages
keywords_en: Cases of unpaid project funds and migrant workers' wages
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Urgent Notice on Concentrated Efforts to Clear Delinquent Construction Project Payments and Migrant Workers' Wages

Fa [2004] No. 259

To the Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; and the Production and Construction Corps Division of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The resolution of delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages in the construction sector is of vital importance to the immediate interests of the people, the healthy development of the national economy, and social stability. The Central Committee of the Communist Party of China attaches great importance to this issue. The State Council has established an inter-ministerial joint conference system and convened a national teleconference on clearing delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages on August 23, 2004. On October 29, it issued the document Guo Ban Fa [2004] No. 78, entitled "Notice on Further Resolving the Issue of Delinquent Construction Project Payments in the Construction Sector," which explicitly requires governments at all levels to complete the task of clearing delinquent construction project payments in the construction sector within three years, and to settle all migrant workers' wages owed before the end of 2003 before the Spring Festival of 2005, with provincial-level people's governments taking responsibility for overall coordination and resolution. On November 29, the Inter-Ministerial Working Consultation Meeting on Resolving Delinquent Construction Project Payments in the Construction Sector further issued the document Jian Shi Dian [2004] No. 57, entitled "Notice on Promptly Ensuring the Payment of Migrant Workers' Wages." People's courts at all levels should seize this opportunity, follow the requirement of justice for the people, attach high importance to resolving delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages in the construction sector, and effectively handle the enforcement of cases involving construction project payments and migrant workers' wages. To this end, the following urgent notice is hereby given:

1. People's courts at all levels shall make full use of the working mechanism established by people's governments at all levels to resolve the issue of delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages, promptly communicate and coordinate with local governments and relevant departments, and notify the relevant people's governments and departments of the enforcement cases accepted by the people's courts concerning delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages in the construction sector, so as to seek the assistance, support, and cooperation of the government and relevant departments, thereby enabling such cases to be enforced more promptly and effectively.

2. People's courts at all levels shall classify and compile statistics on cases of delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages that remain unenforced as of December 20, 2004, according to projects funded by central government budget appropriations, projects invested in by local people's governments at all levels, and projects invested in and developed by enterprises, and report them level by level to the relevant higher people's court. For enforcement cases involving delinquent construction project payments under central investment projects, each higher people's court shall compile and report them to the Enforcement Work Office of the Supreme People's Court before December 30 of this year.

3. For enforcement cases involving delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages under local government investment projects that need to be transferred to local people's governments at all levels for clearance and assistance in enforcement, each higher people's court shall promptly formulate a work plan suitable for the actual circumstances of its jurisdiction, organize its implementation in a unified manner, and notify the provincial-level people's government of the list of cases transferred to local people's governments at all levels for clearance and assistance in enforcement.

4. In the process of clearing enforcement cases of delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages, people's courts at all levels shall handle them promptly according to different circumstances: For delinquent construction project payments under central government investment projects, the Supreme People's Court shall uniformly transfer them to the relevant departments of the State Council, which shall be responsible for clearance and assisting the people's court in completing enforcement by the end of March 2005; for delinquent construction project payments under investment and construction projects of local people's governments at all levels, the enforcing court shall transfer them to the relevant local people's governments, which shall be responsible for clearance and assisting the people's court in completing enforcement by the end of 2005; for delinquent construction project payments under enterprise-invested and developed projects, people's courts at all levels shall, with the assistance of the working mechanism established by people's governments at all levels for resolving delinquent construction project payments, intensify enforcement efforts and complete enforcement of all such cases no later than the end of 2006.

5. In the process of clearing cases of delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages, for cases filed in accordance with the law, people's courts shall file the cases and conclude the trials as soon as possible; for cases where an application is made to the people's court for compulsory enforcement in accordance with the law, the people's court shall handle them promptly and complete enforcement as soon as possible; for cases that need to be transferred to local people's governments for clearance and assistance in enforcement, they shall be dealt with in accordance with the requirements of Article 3 of this Notice.

6. For notarized instruments formed on contracts for the settlement of delinquent construction project payments under projects invested in by state-owned or state-holding enterprises, the debtor shall perform its obligations in accordance with the terms of the notarized contract for the settlement of construction project payments. Where a notarial office has conferred compulsory enforcement effect on such an instrument and the creditor has applied for enforcement, the people's court shall accept the case and, during enforcement, promptly transfer it to the government department in charge of the project, which shall supervise the implementation of the notarized repayment plan or assist the people's court in enforcement.

7. For any case that has been transferred to a people's government at any level for clearance, assistance in enforcement, or resolution, the enforcing court shall promptly notify the parties to the enforcement in writing, and regularly inquire with the relevant people's government and departments about the progress of clearance, promptly coordinate difficulties and problems encountered during the clearance process in such cases, and ensure that the clearance work is effectively implemented. When necessary, the enforcing court shall, ex officio, directly carry out enforcement.

8. In the process of concentrated enforcement of cases involving delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages, entities and individuals that have the capacity to perform but refuse to perform, and maliciously delay payment of construction project payments and migrant workers' wages, shall be sanctioned in accordance with the law. When necessary, the supervisory role of news media public opinion may be utilized, and the list of debtors may be published in the media.

9. For enforcement cases of delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages that have been transferred to local people's governments at all levels for clearance and assistance in enforcement, if the local government fails to clear or assist in enforcement within the prescribed time limit, the enforcing court shall promptly report the matter level by level to the provincial higher people's court. The provincial higher people's court shall promptly provide feedback on the matter to the provincial people's government.

10. In the work of clearing enforcement cases of delinquent construction project payments and migrant workers' wages, people's courts at all levels shall firmly rely on the leadership of Party committees, the supervision of people's congresses, and the support of governments; shall strengthen investigation and research, promptly identify problems, summarize experience, take measures, and promote the in-depth development of clearance and enforcement work; shall pay attention to doing a good job of mass work, strive to avoid the escalation of conflicts, and effectively maintain social stability. Progress in the work and any problems encountered shall be promptly reported to the Supreme People's Court.

This notice is hereby given.

December 21, 2004
